title: Inbound Message Request (v1)
description: Request body for POST /v1/adapters/{adapterId}/messages. adapterId is supplied by the route and is not duplicated in payloads. conversationKey is opaque and stable within that adapter namespace. Idempotency key is (adapterId, messageId): first acceptance returns HTTP 202 status 'accepted'; identical replay returns HTTP 200 status 'duplicate' with the original correlation id; same key plus different canonical payload is a conflict (HTTP 409). The correlation id is core-generated and stable for replays. The acceptance response is validated by inbound-accepted-v1.json. 'addressed' is a boolean indicating whether the agent was directly invoked (activation policy seam).

messageId.description: Non-empty opaque string identifying this message within the adapter.

conversationKey.description: Opaque, stable conversation key within the adapter namespace.

speaker.description: The party that produced the message.

text.description: Message text. May be empty only when attachments is non-empty.

attachments.description: Attachments referenced by workspace-relative POSIX path. May be empty only when text is non-empty.

addressed.description: Whether the agent was directly invoked by this message (activation policy seam). true means the message explicitly targets the agent; false means it is ambient/contextual within the conversation.

allOf.description: Reject a message where text is empty and attachments is empty.

Speaker.description: A party in an adapter conversation.

id.description: Non-empty opaque speaker identifier within the adapter.

WorkspaceAttachment.description: Attachment referenced by a workspace-relative POSIX path. Consumers enforce runtime path safety; this contract never carries inline bytes.

path.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path to the attachment.

name.description: Optional display name for the attachment.

mediaType.description: Optional IANA media type of the attachment.
